evidence: Exempt by derivation, not merely by basis. data/wesselmann_2018_ostracism_veterans.py melts the PLOS S1 .sav on the literal column list [f'dis{i}' for i in range(1,6)], so the IRW item code IS the source column name (derivation pattern 1: no rename, no positional assignment), and the .sav variable label on each column ties that column to its wording: 5/5 item codes present verbatim in the .sav header, 5/5 carrying their own variable label, transcribed character-for-character. No positional step exists that could permute text across codes. The resp AXIS did carry inference (the .sav has 0 value labels; direction taken from the paper) and was checked numerically, N=127-128: dis1R/dis3R/dis5R equal 7-dis_i exactly (max |diff|=0); the file's own distress composite equals mean(dis1R,dis2,dis3R,dis4,dis5R) exactly (max |diff|=0) vs up to 3.00 off for the raw mean; that composite correlates +0.732 ptsd, +0.757 traitanx, +0.703 stateanx, -0.532 support, so low raw = more distress, i.e. 1=All of the time, 6=Never as the paper states. This establishes the item-to-text mapping and the resp direction; it establishes nothing about the 4 unlabelled middle scale points, which ship blank.

Exempt by derivation. The same processing script melts msp1..msp14 under their own names, so item code = source column name. 14/14 codes present verbatim in the PLOS S1 .sav header, 14/14 carrying a full SPSS variable label with the verbatim wording, all labels 46-197 chars (under the 255 truncation cap, so no label is a prefix of another). No positional step exists. Establishes item-to-text correspondence only; the .sav has no value labels and the paper anchors only the 1 and 5 endpoints, so the 3 middle scale points ship blank and are not established by anything.

Exempt by derivation. The same script melts need1..need20 verbatim, so item code = source column name; no positional step. Corroborated across two independent sources: all 20 SPSS variable labels in the PLOS S1 .sav match the authors' OSF codebook (https://osf.io/enp9g/, sha256 b3e1ee71...8a9c) 20/20 verbatim, the only difference being a sentence-final period absent from the .sav label for need18. Establishes item-to-text correspondence; the 1-5 anchors come from the codebook and only the 2 endpoints are labelled, so 3 scale points ship blank.
